data.one_liner: Integrates Google reCAPTCHA v2 into your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Enables seamless integration of Google reCAPTCHA v2 into your app using an in-app web view without needing an external web page. It provides a widget to render the captcha and handles verification tokens.
use_when: You need to implement Google reCAPTCHA v2 verification within your Flutter app
You want to display reCAPTCHA in a bottom sheet or widget without external browser setup
avoid_when: You need reCAPTCHA v3 instead of v2
You cannot allow cleartext traffic on Android apps
strengths: Embeds reCAPTCHA v2 directly inside the app
Easy to configure and use with simple callbacks
weaknesses: Requires enabling cleartext traffic on Android
data.setup_notes: Android requires adding android:usesCleartextTraffic="true" under the application tag in AndroidManifest.xml.
